❗️The rise of AI writing is leaving a stylistic footprint on the web.

Pewresearch:

"And as more AI-generated content appears online, these and other AI “tells” have become more common across webpages. Comparing the internet of today to a snapshot from 2023:

• Em dashes appear about twice as frequently.
• Oxford commas see a 63% increase.
• Certain words that AI models like to use (such as “delve,” “interplay” or “testament”) have more than doubled in usage.
• Using “negative parallelism” to structure a comparison (“it’s not just X, it’s Y”) has nearly tripled, although this is still fairly rare overall."

🤖 ChatGPT can now send iMessages

ChatGPT is getting a serious upgrade on Mac: it can now connect to Messages and actually interact with your conversations.

The new Messages plugin can find chats, catch you up on messages you missed, draft replies, and even send messages for you.

It can also connect the dots between your messages and calendar, like spotting someone’s birthday in a chat, adding it to your calendar, or finding an open evening for dinner.

ChatGPT can flag conversations that look like spam, turning your messages into something it can actually help manage instead of just summarize.
